headline: Jared Kushner warns Israel is heading toward becoming a global pariah state
label: NEWS
caption:
Former US official Jared Kushner warns that Israel is currently on a path toward global pariah status. 🌍

According to Middle East Eye and Haaretz, Kushner stated in a New York Magazine interview that Israel stands at a critical crossroads following the events of October 7, 2023.

He warned that the country can either choose to become more secure and integrated globally or continue on its current trajectory.
